```{r}

## Beispiel:
## max z = 3 x1 + 2 x2
## s.t.  x1 + x2 <= 4
##      2x1 + x2 <= 5
##      x1, x2 >= 0

# Koeffizientenmatrix der Nebenbedingungen (inkl. Schlupfvariablen)
A <- matrix(c(1, 1, 1, 0,
              2, 1, 0, 1),
            nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)

# Rechte Seiten
b <- c(4, 5)

# Zielfunktion: 3 x1 + 2 x2  (Slack-Koeffizienten = 0)
c_vec <- c(3, 2, 0, 0)

# Hilfsfunktion: Simplex-Tableau ausgeben
print_tableau <- function(A, b, c_vec, z0 = 0, basis_idx, iter = 0) {
  m <- nrow(A)
  n <- ncol(A)
  cat("===== Simplex-Tableau, Iteration", iter, "=====\n")
  tab <- cbind(A, b)
  colnames(tab) <- c(paste0("x", 1:n), "RHS")
  rownames(tab) <- paste0("B", 1:m)
  print(round(tab, 3))
  z_row <- c(-c_vec, z0)  # übliche Schul-Notation: Zielfunktion negiert
  names(z_row) <- c(paste0("x", 1:n), "RHS")
  cat("Zielfunktion (z-Zeile):\n")
  print(round(z_row, 3))
  cat("Basisvariablen:", paste(paste0("x", basis_idx), collapse = ", "), "\n\n")
}


simplex_step <- function(A, b, c_vec, basis_idx, z0 = 0, iter = 0) {
  m <- nrow(A)
  n <- ncol(A)

  # Tableau ausgeben
  print_tableau(A, b, c_vec, z0, basis_idx, iter)

  # reduzierte Kosten (hier in Schul-Notation einfach -c)
  red_costs <- -c_vec

  # Optimalitätstest: keine negativen reduzierten Kosten in Nichtbasis
  nonbasis_idx <- setdiff(1:n, basis_idx)
  if (all(red_costs[nonbasis_idx] >= -1e-9)) {
    cat("Optimalität erreicht.\n")
    return(list(A = A, b = b, c = c_vec, basis = basis_idx, z0 = z0,
                optimal = TRUE))
  }

  # Eintrittsvariable: Spalte mit minimalem reduzierten Kostenwert
  entering <- nonbasis_idx[which.min(red_costs[nonbasis_idx])]

  # Quotiententest
  col_enter <- A[, entering]
  valid <- col_enter > 1e-9
  if (!any(valid)) {
    stop("Problem unbeschränkt (keine gültige Pivotzeile).")
  }
  ratios <- b[valid] / col_enter[valid]
  pivot_row <- which(valid)[which.min(ratios)]

  cat("Eintrittsvariable: x", entering,
      "  (Spalte ", entering, ")\n", sep = "")
  cat("Austrittsvariable: x", basis_idx[pivot_row],
      "  (Zeile ", pivot_row, ")\n\n", sep = "")

  # Pivot-Operation
  pivot <- A[pivot_row, entering]
  A[pivot_row, ] <- A[pivot_row, ] / pivot
  b[pivot_row]   <- b[pivot_row]   / pivot

  for (i in seq_len(m)) {
    if (i == pivot_row) next
    factor <- A[i, entering]
    A[i, ] <- A[i, ] - factor * A[pivot_row, ]
    b[i]   <- b[i]   - factor * b[pivot_row]
  }

  # Zielfunktion anpassen (einfache Variante)
  factor_z <- c_vec[entering]
  c_vec <- c_vec - factor_z * A[pivot_row, ]
  z0    <- z0 + factor_z * b[pivot_row]

  # Basis aktualisieren
  basis_idx[pivot_row] <- entering

  list(A = A, b = b, c = c_vec, basis = basis_idx, z0 = z0,
       optimal = FALSE)
}


# Startbasis: Schlupfvariablen x3, x4
basis_idx <- c(3, 4)

state <- list(A = A, b = b, c = c_vec,
              basis = basis_idx, z0 = 0)

iter <- 0
repeat {
  res <- simplex_step(state$A, state$b, state$c,
                      state$basis, state$z0, iter = iter)
  if (isTRUE(res$optimal)) {
    state <- res
    break
  }
  state <- res
  iter <- iter + 1
}

# Optimale Lösung aus dem finalen Tableau ablesen
m <- nrow(state$A); n <- ncol(state$A)
x <- rep(0, n)
for (i in 1:m) {
  x[state$basis[i]] <- state$b[i]
}
cat("Optimale Variablebelegung:\n")
print(round(x, 3))
cat("Optimaler Zielfunktionswert z* =", round(state$z0, 3), "\n")


```

|     | x₁  | x₂  | s₁  | s₂  | RHS |
|-----|-----|-----|-----|-----|-----|
| s₁  | 1   | 1   | 1   | 0   | 4   |
| s₂  | 2   | 1   | 0   | 1   | 5   |
| z   | -3  | -2  | 0   | 0   | 0   |
